context.description: /task trust reaches the live run once

evidence.trustReason: A real TaskCommand job resumes a stored release-notes slice under the real harness, Recorder, event store and supervisors; before trust, T1.5 waits only on untrusted T9. The actual /task trust T9 command writes the directory aggregate and exactly one run fact; folding immediately before and after it shows T1.5 ready, then the live supervisor starts T1.5. Trust commands for a task, unknown id and already-trusted T9 leave the run aggregate unchanged, while an untrusted T8 control forwards. A trust before a new run appears exactly once directly after run.started and moves T9 from untrusted to trusted.

context.gherkin:

    When /task trust T9 runs in the directory
